headword: {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}
gloss: proof of qualification; certification; credential verification

definitions.gloss: proof of qualification; certification; credential verification
definitions.explanation: A document or process that verifies a person holds a particular qualification, license, or credential. Common in job applications, visa processes, and professional registration.

examples.japanese: {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit your proof of qualification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Proof of qualification is required for the application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交付|こうふ}→交付：11425_koufu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数週間|すうしゅうかん}→数週間：21615_suushuukan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It can take several weeks to receive a certificate of eligibility for residence status.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (qualification, eligibility) and ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧ (proof, certification). Frequently appears in administrative and bureaucratic contexts, especially immigration paperwork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: certificate of qualification
- ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: certificate of eligibility (for residence status in Japan)
- {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain proof of qualification
- {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit proof of qualification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}→免許証：03160_menkyoshou⟧: license — a specific official document granting permission (driver's license, teaching license)
- ⟦{資格|しかく}{証|しょう}→資格証：26034_shikakushou⟧: qualification certificate — the certificate itself, while {資格|しかく}{証明|しょうめい} emphasizes the act or process of proving
- ⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: accreditation document — a broader term for official recognition documents
